reviews.title: Its great, had a few issues with win11 not booting with bios, but its stable now.
reviews.comment:
Just roll back a driver for bios (non beta) but recent on website and install win11. Wouldn't recommend booting on hhd get a nvme m.2 waste of time, so slow.
Love the bios flashback, and m.2 slots.
Honestly if this had bluetooth and wifi it would be a pretty competitive board.
reviews.author: Ruku Sokudo

reviews.title: Fantastic low-budget option
reviews.comment:
Nice board, running Team Group T-Force 6000mhz (2x 16) sticks of ram, with absolutely no problems. Ryzen 7800x3d cpu, Water cooled with a 240mm Thermalright Aio, 1tb Neo Forza 4.0 nvme, with a Evga RTX 3060 12 Gb Gpu. Every thing works very well together Very impressed with this low-budget motherboard love asrock best price to proformance out there, plus is very nice looking with  silverish heat sinks there not white picture looks white.
loving this computer build. Update,  been almost a year now sence build and all is fine runs really good going to upgrade my gpu to a new 5000 rtx or Rx 8000 upon launch. Will update after release.
